interrupted_attempt.context: A prior attempted final run began while the 32 GiB overlay was at 100% capacity. It was interrupted and is not counted as a passing validation run.
interrupted_attempt.observation: The first pages intermittently threw a user.is_admin undefined error after HTTP-200 authentication responses. A later direct read returned a complete user object. The exact transient response body was not captured, so the disk condition is context, not a proven root cause.
interrupted_attempt.followup: Root subsequently hardened invalid JSON / HTTP-200 error / null-object API responses and strict /me user validation, with separate unit tests owned by root. This new build passed all 94 real-backend states after a healthy preflight. This browser run observed valid real responses and does not claim to inject or simulate malformed responses.

limits: The few-event fixture has real persisted analytics events but does not populate every management namespace. Empty management lists and forms are verified without claiming record-editing coverage.
Identity, funnel, replay, export and saved-report flows needing an existing child record are covered only through entry views and available fixture records.
No live provider/model call, notification send, destructive action, purchase, credential creation or production deployment was requested.
This is observed desktop/mobile rendering plus functional response and semantic checks, not a claim of complete accessibility or production-capacity certification.
